Some Pros: - The ability to multitask while you drive (provided you had muscle control over the tail) - The ability to operate a mouse while typing. - YOU HAVE A TAIL

Some Cons: - Your tail would get scrunched up in conventional chairs. - You may get confused and chase your own tail. - If the tail has no fur, it would look gross.
Let's say all human beings grew tails overnight. What would the pros and cons be?

Swimming would be a lot different- utilizing it in some capacity to propel yourself further. Women would now now the trial and tribulations of having something instinctively reacting to the world around them without any input from the user. A lot of contact sports would need new rules, but the addition it would bring to sports like soccer or wrestling would be awesome! Imagine dudes with tails playing soccer! "Hogan is off the ropes, Piper spins around and he gets a tail to the face!" That visual alone was worth entertaining this mind game for me.

Cons: Doors would have to be redesigned. I don't think revolving doors would be as popular. Moving through crowds would be more cumbersome, but the addition of increased personal space would probably be welcome to most.

Tails would probably be weaponized in some way, because you know humans love weaponizing things!

It would probably start off simple with a little mace-like cap people could wear on the end of their tail. Of course, if tails have unintended, emotional reactions, this could lead to some unfortunate accidents. Imagine hitting yourself in the face with your mace-tail because you got startled.
I also think soccer would penalize "tail-balling". Only the keeper is allowed to use their tail.

I suppose, like you said, it would really depend on how much control we have over the tail. Maybe like all other muscles, we have a decent amount of control and like working out we could increase the level of control we have over our tails?

I guess I imagine life would adjust. It's not like you and your tail wouldn't be used to brushing up against people/things while walking so it wouldn't feel out of place to shop and pass by people. This of course plays into the ability to control your tail so that if you had to pass someone in a tight space you could manipulate it to help make such things possible.

And if they aren't super sensitive then it could a lot of really really really fun stuff...

On the other hand, sex harassment cases for grabbing tails and public indecency for stroking your tail in public might become a thing..

It's also possible that maybe the tail would become something taboo in certain cultures. Maybe showing someone your tail is a sign of trust and intimacy, so we would have to walk around with giant tail socks.

Oh man, a whole other level of religion and debate wars.

I mean tails could be, for the sake of not offending anyone, could be require to be sort of "tucked" into pants legs (which of course pants would be made to do this comfortably) or just tail socks for all
